reason: I check how long a seller's been on the platform and read their reviews, and this one has neither. Used sets on Marketplace and eBay are about the same money and at least I can see the seller's history.
objection: New seller, no reviews. Anyone can say they repair cracks and bends, and I can't tell if the refinish will hold up or if it's a bent wheel under fresh paint. Tyres not included makes it dearer than it looks.
would_change_my_mind: A few real reviews or a seller history I can check, or a price around £180 with tyres included so I'm not gambling on an unknown.
